children: HPE (NYSE: HPE) will host its Networking Investor Day on September 30, 2026, in Sunnyvale, California. Join the live webcast for an in-depth presentation on the HPE Networking business from Rami Rahim, executive vice president, president, and general manager, Networking, HPE.

Additional Networking executives will also participate in the event and take part in a live panel discussion. The program will highlight HPE Networking’s strategy, portfolio differentiation, and growth opportunities, and include a live Q&A session.
The webcast will begin Wednesday, September 30, at 10:30 a.m. CT (8:30 a.m. PT) and will be available at
A replay of the webcast will be available at the same website shortly after the event and will remain available for approximately one year. For additional information, see
